facts.fact: The DPI Map (UCL IIPP) lists Mauritania's data exchange system as planned or piloted; checked 2024-10, so as_of is that check date.

Mauritania's Director General of National Security said on 18 December 2025 that the WAPIS police data system has been connected to law enforcement bodies at 62 sub-stations (47 police, 11 gendarmerie, 4 customs), with its operating manual due to enter service at the start of the following year.
